policy.title: Catalog hash enforcement is BLOCKING in the generation pipeline
policy.description: When the runner executes _stage_scenario_planning, a catalog hash mismatch against the denominator file halts the pipeline. This prevents generating examples from a drifted API catalog.

enforcement_points.behavior: Call validate_catalog_hash non-strict to get result and write evidence. Then check result.match is False and raise CatalogHashMismatchError. Add scenario_planning to HARD_STOP_STAGES.
enforcement_points.rationale: Evidence must always be captured for diagnostics, even when blocking.

enforcement_points.behavior: Pass strict=True to validate_catalog_hash. This blocks direct callers of plan_scenarios from silently proceeding on mismatch.
enforcement_points.rationale: Belt-and-suspenders. If someone calls plan_scenarios directly (e.g., future CLI command), they also get strict enforcement.

non_strict_paths_preserved: Direct calls to validate_catalog_hash() with strict=False (default) for diagnostics/reporting
discovery-sweep commands that inspect catalogs without generating

graceful_degradation.no_denominator_file: match=None, pipeline proceeds (new families without denominator are allowed)
graceful_degradation.no_api_catalog_sha256_field: match=None, pipeline proceeds (denominator not yet populated with hash)
graceful_degradation.hash_mismatch: HARD STOP — CatalogHashMismatchError raised, evidence written, pipeline halts

policy.rationale_no_flag: Generation should never proceed with a drifted catalog. An override flag would weaken the guarantee. Users should update the denominator file if the catalog legitimately changed.
